title: 'I tell my children it’s just thunder': How ordinary Iranians are dealing with war
summary: As US and Israeli airstrikes continue to pound Iran, many residents there live in fear, choosing to limit outings as much as possible. France 24's Carys Garland and Ludovic de Foucaud take a look at how one family are trying as best they can to continue life as normal amid the constant threat of bombardments.
